Medium-sized Ulgarm makes its first appearance.
Isn't this design incredible? It really makes you feel like there's no way you can win.

By the way, the name was changed from Juggernaut in the web version to Ulgarm in the print version, and a big reason was that "it sounded too strong". But looking at this design, it feels like maybe Juggernaut would have been fine after all.
The hero comes to the heroine's rescue!
When a character who's put you through this much misery finally becomes an ally, how dependable they feel is off the charts.
Proactive self-defense.
The heroine gets hurt while protecting Subaru and Meili.
Puppy Ulgarm (Bossgarm) appears.
Reboot.
This is Rem's first "oni transformation," isn't it.

The title "The Meaning of Courage" is taken from the narration when they enter the forest to save the children. As Subaru says, "I didn't know courage could be this frightening," so it's the scene where he overcomes that fear and goes into the forest. It's also the moment when Rem's opinion of Subaru changed, at least a little.
Basically, I structure it so the titles are taken from the web version's subtitles.

This episode reveals what all those countless points of light floating in the second half of the ED really are. In other words, the ones that appear later are the enemies who put kill marks on Subaru... how novel!

By the way, in the second half of the OP, Elsa's knife and Rem's iron ball appear for just a moment, and those are also the weapons that put kill marks on Subaru. Isn't it novel that instead of the protagonists' weapons, the weapons that killed the protagonist are what appear?

Well then, thank you again this week for staying with me so late into the night... late? Or rather, until early in the morning! Looks like next week will probably be nerve-racking too, but I don't think the timeslot will be any later than today. I don't think so. Maybe. Well, brace yourselves a little!
